title: Verify Prev/Next buttons are not reachable with Tab and have no accessible name
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Current behaviour is documented; if keyboard accessibility becomes a requirement this case is a defect and its expected result flips (see OPEN RISKS)
steps: Click on the "Featured Projects" heading (a non-interactive element) to set the keyboard starting point
Press Tab up to 15 times and after each press record document.activeElement
Read the tabindex, role and aria-label attributes of #carousel__prev and #carousel__next
expected_result: Neither #carousel__prev nor #carousel__next ever receives focus during the Tab sequence (tabindex is -1). Both elements have no aria-label and no role attribute.

title: Verify arrow keys do not move the carousel
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
Current behaviour is documented; if keyboard support is added this case must be updated
steps: Click on the "Featured Projects" heading to move focus to the page body area
Read the translate3d X offset of the slide track
Press ArrowRight 3 times, then ArrowLeft 3 times
Read the translate3d X offset again and check the browser console for uncaught errors
expected_result: The track offset is unchanged after the key presses and no uncaught JavaScript error is raised.
